correctness.rationale: For each vertex v, conditioning on D_v=d leaves all nonincident orientations independent fair, so every directed ell-cycle through v has d(m-d)(m-2)_{ell-3} candidate internal orders with probability 2^{-(ell-2)}. Linearity and binomial identities establish all exact covariance formulas. The rank is one because all rows are positive multiples of ell=3 and a nonzero entry exists. Positive prefactors, centered-binomial algebra and unimodality establish the exact bin and threshold signs. Exact exhaustive exact enumeration through six vertices validates 90 covariance entries; 89,996 further finite sign checks support but are not substituted for the analytic proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General extremal cycle counts are not probabilistic covariances. Directed graph Bernoulli edge models with independently present ordered arcs are not automatically random tournaments with exactly one orientation per undirected edge. A sufficiently general graph-motif projection theorem might nonetheless imply the rank-one covariance after specialization; this is an explicit residual risk.

value.rationale: The full directed-cycle count vector and the vertex outdegree histogram are central diagnostics of random tournament orientation. Their exact cross-covariance matrix has rank one, uniformly for all lengths and sizes: a structural dimension collapse, not routine marginal enumeration. Every additive score-statistic adjustment reduces to triangles, while exact score-class and cumulative-threshold signs (including square-order zeros) give naturally complete dependence classifications. The result explicitly avoids stronger stochastic-independence claims.
